question: Do the cross-domain NASA features add anything on top of the in-domain Moonstone features when simply concatenated, and does either feature source help the coarser 5-class Age task more than Geology?

feature_sets.nasa_768: verified NASA pretrained pooled tokens, width 768
feature_sets.fusion_1024: column concatenation of the two, width 1024, same row order

tasks.geology: 49 classes, targets from the authenticated metadata
tasks.age: 5 classes, targets from the authenticated P3.2 cache (derived from the same ordered IDs)

heads.linear_balanced: Linear(d, C) with inverse-sqrt-frequency class weights

grid: 3 feature sets x 2 tasks x 2 heads x 3 seeds = 36 runs
acceptance: Ordered Train/Val IDs agree across the NASA manifest and every Moonstone cache
Age targets come only from the authenticated cache, never from names or IDs
Macro-F1 is computed over the full class count, absent classes included
No Test ID is read or scored
reporting: Mean and sample standard deviation over three seeds
Fusion minus Moonstone delta per task and head
Age class support for Train and Val
